_readme: Golden evaluation set for the food mapping system. 'search' cases hit GET /api/foods/search (manual search); 'nlp' cases hit POST /api/nlp/parse (magic log; items[] bypasses AI segmentation unless 'text' is used). PASS RULE (search): a result within the top `rank` has ALL substrings of at least one alternative in `match` present in its lowercased 'name + brandName'. PASS RULE (nlp): expectName (any item matches), optional expectItems (min count), optional macros (per-100g band on items[0].nutritionPer100g), optional grams (band on items[0].grams — the RESOLVED serving weight), optional total (band on items[0].nutrition — the BILLED totals for the requested quantity; keys calories/protein/carbs/fat/fiber/sugar/sodium). INVARIANT (search): every top-`rank` hit must carry at least one finite macro (verifies the OFF null-nutrition filter); opt out with requireNutrition:false. FLAG knownIssue:true marks a documented-but-unfixed defect — its failure is EXPECTED, reported as 🟡, and does NOT fail the suite (used to catalog serving-estimation gaps as regression targets). Macro/gram bands are deliberately loose: they catch wrong-food and wrong-portion mappings, not data noise. NEW ASSERTIONS (2026-07-25): `forbidName` (same shape as expectName) fails if ANY returned item matches — pins a wrong-record class without having to name the right answer. `expectAbstain: true` requires the mapper to return NO confident pick, for queries whose honest answer is 'not in the corpus' (billing a component at 0.95 is worse than abstaining). `maxConfidence: <n>` is the weak form — it may guess but must not look cacheable. IMPORTANT: an abstention can no longer satisfy `expectName`. The no-pick branch echoes the QUERY TEXT back as foodName, so `expectName:[['burrito']]` used to be satisfied by a total abstention on 'chipotle chicken burrito' — 47 of the nlp cases assert a name and no numeric band, so 47 cases could pass on nothing at all. CALORIE-BLINDNESS CLASS (2026-07-26): a case that asserts only expectName + grams is blind to a wrong PANEL on a right-named record — n-supp-23 passed for months while billing 952.2 kcal for a 414 g bottle containing 230, because off_9568310020398 stores the whole-bottle panel in nutrientsPer100g. Measured BEFORE this change (2026-07-26): 47 of 243 nlp cases carried NO numeric band, and a further 119 carried `grams` with no `macros`/`total` — 166 of 243 could not see a 4x over-bill. AFTER this change: 37 / 112 / 149. Both figures are a 2026-07-26 SNAPSHOT of that PR's delta and are deliberately frozen so it stays legible — they are NOT the current corpus. Cases added since have moved them (38 / 113 / 150 at 2026-08-15), and the live counts are pinned, with a dated note per movement, in scripts/eval/__tests__/winner-diff.test.ts, which is their owner; re-derive there, not here. STANDING RULE: any nlp case that pins ONE food (single `item`, or `text` with expectItems 1) SHOULD carry `total.calories`; add `macros.kcal100` as well whenever the per-100g figure is the discriminator (RTD drink vs powder, raw vs oil, cooked vs dry). Bands are set from the product's published figure with roughly +/-35% width, NOT from the currently-observed value, so a repoint to a correct sibling still passes. Segmentation cases with expectItems >= 2 are deliberately left unbanded: the bands only inspect items[0], and which record lands at index 0 is a segmentation artifact rather than the thing under test. NEW ASSERTION (2026-08-17): `expectServingTier` (a tier name, a `prefix*` glob such as `bare_*`, or a list of alternatives) bands the serving rung that billed items[0] — `servingTier` as the pipeline stamps it (names owned by src/lib/mapping/serving-ai-tiers.ts and the census in src/lib/mapping/__tests__/serving-tier-census.test.ts). It is SCORED ONLY WHEN THE RESPONSE ITEM CARRIES `servingTier`, which /api/nlp/parse sends only to the dev bypass with `debug=1` — run-eval sends that in --nocache mode, so the band is judged cold and SKIPPED (fail-open, never a failure) warm; with the key present a null tier is a mismatch. The `prose` category (n-prose-01..16, 2026-08-17) is the first user of it: full-sentence lines with hedges (about/roughly/around/like/maybe/nearly), partitives (some/a bit of/a handful of/a slice of) and filler. Its one-item lines carry TRUTH bands (the published weight, not the pipeline's current bill — the egg-white case is banded to USDA's 243 g cup and stays knownIssue until the sibling-borrow lands); its multi-item lines assert expectItems + identities only, per the rule above.

COMPOSITE->COMPONENT drift. The mapper answers a composite-dish query with one of its COMPONENTS at cache-worthy confidence, so the line bills a small fraction of the real meal and looks authoritative doing it. Under-counting by 5-10x is more severe than any serving-size bug in this suite. DIAGNOSIS CORRECTED 2026-07-25 eve — the original note here blamed a CORPUS GAP and that is WRONG. A direct probe of gather+filter post-#150 (the venue-brand disqualifier fix) shows the correct assembled record IS in the rerank pool for every case in this group. It loses the RANKING. Confirmed the honest way: the cache row was evicted and the query re-resolved cold through deployed master, which is authoritative in a way a probe is not (a probe that reimplements the caller's argument list is a different function - ours passed aiNutritionEstimate=undefined and so never engaged the plausibility partition or the nutrition tiebreaker, and it over-predicted as a result). NAIVE FIX STILL DOES NOT WORK: 'reject when the query's head noun is absent from the winner' kills these correctly but also kills 'impossible burger patty' -> 'Impossible Burger', because burger/patty are synonyms while chicken/burrito is ingredient-of. And a GATE is the wrong instrument at all: a hard reject sets winner=null and the null path falls through to AI backfill at grams ?? 100, replacing a silently wrong number with a differently wrong one. The fix is a RELATIVE coverage-dominance sort partition in simple-rerank (demote a strict-subset-coverage candidate only when a full-coverage candidate is present in the same pool), which is provably inert on n-mq-42 and on 'impossible burger patty'. THIS CASE: live 2026-07-25 after eviction and cold re-resolve: 'Chipotle, Chicken' 118.294g / 165.6 kcal, i.e. it re-picked the same component. The pool contains four assembled 'Chipotle Chicken Burrito' OFF records (Morrisons, las IGUANAS, The Gym Kitchen, one unbranded) - they are UK ready-meals rather than Chipotle Mexican Grill's own, but the assertion asks for a burrito in a gram/kcal band, not for that chain. ASSERTION NOTE: no forbidName or maxConfidence is added here, and both were tried and removed. forbidName is redundant - expectName already requires the dish noun ('burrito'/'bowl') which every component in this class lacks, so the existing assertion already pins it. It is also actively unsafe for n-mq-40, where the component name 'Harissa' is a SUBSTRING of the correct answer 'Harissa Avocado Curated Bowl', so a substring forbid would make the case unpassable even once fixed. And maxConfidence is the wrong shape for a RANKING failure: it says 'if you must guess, do not look authoritative', which suits a corpus gap - here the goal is a confident CORRECT answer, so capping confidence would fail the case precisely when it starts working. What #152 actually buys this group is the abstention guard: before it, a future gate that made these abstain would have flipped them to FALSE GREEN, because the no-pick branch echoes the query text back as foodName and 'burrito' is in the query.
